subject: Compliance add-on cost split, evidence delivery cadence & amortization request
messages:
From: Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@uptonhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@uptonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: compliance add-ons & evidence schedule

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo earlier — Upton liked the latency profile. Procurement asked me to follow up with a clear line-item breakdown for the compliance/security add-ons (audit log retention tiers, KMS/HSM seat vs. per-key usage, and EU data residency). They also want to understand how evidence (SOC reports, onboarding attestations, supplier questionnaires) will be delivered and whether any one-time implementation fees can be amortized into monthly credits.

Attached is the draft SOW your SE sent; procurement highlighted two asks: a) show a 12-month amortization option for onboarding fees, and b) show a zone-based residency surcharge (EU vs US) separately from the HSM seat.

Can you send a cost table plus suggested concession structuring by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks,
Anjali Rao
Sr. Sourcing Manager, Upton Health
Procurement: procurement@uptonhealth.com
Attachment: Upton_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@uptonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: compliance add-ons & evidence schedule

Hi Anjali — appreciate the clear asks and the SOW. I pulled together a quick matrix (see attached evidence_matrix.xlsx) and sketched two pricing paths: 1) standard itemized (recurring audit-log retention + per-HSM-seat) and 2) blended (amortized onboarding credit + per-GB egress for residency). High level:

- Audit logs: 30 / 90 / 365 day retention tiers: $0.00 (30d) / $0.02/GB-mo (90d) / $0.05/GB-mo (365d)
- KMS/HSM: $3,000 per HSM seat / month OR $0.0015 per key op (for high-volume telemetry) — seat recommended for customer-managed keys and FIPS attestation requirements
- Data residency premium: +12% for EU region (operational pass-through + higher storage costs); can be listed as a separate recurring surcharge
- Onboarding/evidence package: one-time $45,000 implementation fee (includes SOC evidence handoff, attestation, and SCA). We can offer to amortize this over 12 months as a $3,750 monthly credit against usage invoices.

Ben — can you confirm the HSM seat vs. per-op tradeoffs and whether a hybrid (1 seat + per-op overflow) is supported? Mina — flagging the amortization ask for accounting treatment and whether finance is OK with applying monthly credits against usage invoices.

Incoming: evidence_matrix.xlsx (attachment)

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: compliance add-ons & evidence schedule

Rachel / Mina — quick notes on the HSM options:

- HSM seat (recommended): dedicated HSM instance with customer KMS integration, FIPS-certified; predictable monthly cost ($3,000/mo) and includes key rotation support and attestation artifacts. Good for low-to-medium key-op volume where customers require dedicated tenancy.
- Per-key-op model: supported for very high-volume telemetry or ephemerally keyed workloads; we meter ops at ~0.0015 per op. This avoids provisioning a dedicated HSM but is more variable.
- Hybrid: we can do 1 HSM seat + per-op overflow (automatically routes overflow to shared pool billed per-op). Technical docs: we capture the key-op counts in runtime metrics so billing is straightforward.

Operational caveat: EU residency + HSM seat implies cross-region key residency — if Upton requires EU-only KMS, that affects provisioning lead time (2–4 weeks) and we should bake that into the SOW.

Ben
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@uptonhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@uptonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: compliance add-ons & evidence schedule

Rachel / Ben — thanks, this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from procurement:

1) They prefer the onboarding fee to be amortized; but ask whether the amortization can be applied as a fixed monthly line item (so their internal budget shows a predictable charge) rather than a credit off usage invoices. Will Redwood do a line-item monthly invoice for the fee?

2) For HSM, they are drawn to the hybrid approach. Can Redwood provide an estimate of expected per-op costs for their projected Q1 volumes (we shared the volume profile in the SOW). If the hybrid route is chosen, procurement wants a cap on per-op billing growth (e.g., a 20% overage allowance before forced seat provisioning).

3) Evidence delivery: procurement asked that the initial SOC evidence bundle is delivered within 10 business days of contract signature and that subsequent annual evidence is delivered 30 days after calendar year close. Is that schedule feasible?

Attached: redlined_sow.pdf (they included inline comments)

Appreciate a response by EOD so we can get this in front of legal.

Best,
Anjali
Attachment: redlined_sow.pdf (pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-13T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: compliance add-ons & evidence schedule

Looping in from RevOps — we can accept the amortization as a standalone monthly invoice line (preferred by customer) rather than a usage credit. Mina, please confirm revenue recognition and billing cadence below:

- Implement onboarding fee as 12 equal monthly invoices (invoice code: ONB-UH-912), starting the month after signature.
- Cap: offer a transitional per-op cap (20%) before automatic provisioning of an additional HSM seat; if overflow exceeds cap for two consecutive months, we provision and bill the seat starting the following month.
- Evidence: commit to initial SOC bundle within 10 business days post-signature; annual evidence within 30 days of calendar year close — include this in SOW Exhibit B.

Mina — if accounting/legal signs off, Rachel, please send updated SOW with amended invoicing (line-item monthly onboarding fee), hybrid HSM language w/ cap, and the evidence exhibit. Include DocuSign link and ask for signature + PO.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, RevOps, Redwood Inference
